integrity: Analytical proof plus reproducible finite high-precision checks. Historical priority is provisional; a relevant 2005 source-localization report was not fully inspected; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: One fixed vertical station, perfect ground reflection, one steady source, known receptor heights, noiseless concentrations, no unknown background; only aggregate amplitude is identified. Height recovery is sharply fourth-root conditioned near a ground source.
title: Three-height identifiability and sharp fourth-root conditioning of a ground-reflected Gaussian plume
